lesson: At P = t/2pi the zero set of D_P is a function of zeta near the line through the functional equation (zeta = F*chi, Fresnel weight F = 1/2 at the stationary point), so any phase statistic over those zeros is shared by ZQ. Below that length, zeta's census and both statistics sit inside the Haar ensemble. Two method points: a survivor rule must give every control the same number of windows as zeta (the registered rule did not, and ZQ only showed the effect at 8 windows); and z-scores regressed on zero count extrapolate when zeta has fewer zeros than every Haar draw, so bias-correct by permutation inside each window.
